'''December 2001 Mannheim tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mannheim, Germany on 8 December 2001. It is known from Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3164">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germanyd3164/ mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 12 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-12-mart-08-12-2001-mannheim-germanyd3164/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 8 December 2001
* '''Site:''' Mannheim, Germany
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Players:''' 12
* '''Winner:''' [[Alex Klimo]]<ref name="tr-d3231">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ 09-12-2001-mainz-germany], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 4 January 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-01-04-09-12-2001-mainz-germanyd3231/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
